body:
Triage: `needs-user-decision`.

- **Published-contract shape fork**: `ComponentInput.type` (types/base.ts:215, live @ `f5f8744`) cannot express spec unions, so legal metadata using the undeclared arm draws `type-mismatch` warnings from the repo's own manifest gate (checkType in sdui-parser/validate.ts) — including the inline translation maps that the same inputs' descriptions teach (containers.tsx:703 `page:card.title` is a standing example of the contradiction). Routes: (a) widen `type` to arrays / add a `types` field — changes a published `sdui.manifest.json` field read by the designer and generateDts; (b) add a narrow `i18nString` coarse type; (c) consumer-side leniency — anti-#0.1, listed only for contrast; (d) upstream spec narrowing — mass in-the-wild producers. (a)/(d) are the one-contract directions; both need the maintainer.
- **Routing note**: if (d) is chosen this transfers to the objectstack backlog per the one-main-backlog rule; kept here until the direction is picked so the transfer does not pre-decide it.
- **Cross-links**: twin of PR #3795's open member-shape question. No duplicate found.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**Maintainer ruling (2026-08-09): direction (a) — `ComponentInput.type` learns to express unions.** `pm:queue`.

Extend the published shape so a declaration can carry multiple arms (accept an array in `type`, or an additive `types?: ControlType[]` — implementer's call on encoding, with the constraint that **the existing single-string form stays valid**, so this is a backward-compatible extension of `sdui.manifest.json`). `checkType` passes when any arm matches; both declaration sites (`base.ts:215`, `plugin-scope.ts:172`) move together; consumers (designer panels, `generateDts`) follow in the same PR. Then fix the five measured specimens (the four i18n-map `title`/`subtitle`/`body` inputs and `element:text_input.defaultValue`) to declare their real unions.

Rationale (three-axis): the same `ComponentInput` currently teaches the inline translation map in its description while its `type` makes the manifest gate warn on it — a platform authority contradicting itself, hit today. (a)/(d) are the one-contract directions per #0.1; (c) consumer leniency is the second-dialect shape the repo explicitly rejects; (d) upstream narrowing would break the inline-translation maps' many in-the-wild producers, so (a) is the honest fix. And noise-warnings on legal writes train authors to ignore the true `unknown-prop`/`type-mismatch` signals — killing that noise is the AI-error axis.

Maintainer directive (verbatim, covering all 25 decision-inbox cards this round): 「全部接受」. Recorded by PM session session_01LGRN2cSRfggfX9B2L83bQc. Veto window open — comment to overturn.
